interpretation_guard: search-plan bookkeeping only. No engine search is run here, no verdict is created, no row is closed. WIN7-D10 proves a first-player win within depth 10 from the individual 7-stone root only; REFUTED-D10 is not a LOSS proof; receipt folds are manifest-coverage bookkeeping.
